instructions.text: Stir in the beaten yolks, the milk, the flour, and the rose-water.
Add lastly the beaten whites very lightly and quickly.
Drop in rings or round cakes upon buttered paper, and bake immediately.

source.author: Marion Harland
source.originalInstructions:
1. Cream butter and sugar.
2. Stir in the beaten yolks, the milk, the flour, and the rose-water.
3. Stir in the almonds.
4. Add lastly the beaten whites very lightly and quickly.
5. Drop in rings or round cakes upon buttered paper, and bake immediately.
6. You may substitute grated cocoanut, or the chopped kernels of white walnuts, for the almonds, in which case add a little salt.
